sourceSentences: Hitting champions or large monsters with abilities reduces the cooldown by 4 seconds. Killing enemies reduces it by 1 second.
Only the initial hit of Darkin Daggers counts for reducing We Are More's cooldown; the damage over time will not trigger the cooldown reduction.
Both hits of Eviscerate will trigger the cooldown reduction.
Darkin Daggers can be recast after 0.5 seconds and within 4 seconds at no additional cost.

If the dagger hits a target that is already bleeding, they are instead dealt the remaining bleed damage plus additional bonus physical damage, increased by missing health. If that target is also a champion or large monster, Naafiri heals herself.
Naafiri goes on the hunt for the next 5 seconds, becoming untargetable and ghosted for the first 1 second.
Casting Hounds' Pursuit extends The Call of the Pack's hunt duration by 1.75 seconds, up to its original duration.
If Naafiri scores a champion takedown within 7 seconds of cast, she triggers a pulse ... She can also recast Hounds' Pursuit once from triggering this effect within 12 seconds at no cost.
Recast: Naafiri immediately grants herself a shield for 3 seconds before mimicking the first cast's effects.
Hound's Pursuit's cast and dash do not break stealth.
Spell shield will block Naafiri's collision damage but cannot prevent collision damage from Packmates.
For combos: To initiate, start with W, then Q and E. Attack before the second Q before moving away. And for a full lunge, use W, then Q and the ultimate. Instantly E, then Q, before moving away.
Use W to avoid an enemy's key abilities while getting close to them. But remember, your W resets the turret's focus on you.
She can use this ability again within the next 4 seconds, and if it hits a target that is already bleeding, it absorbs all the bleeding and deals additional damage.
If she scores a kill within 7 seconds, this ability resets and she gains a large shield when used again.
